experiences.title: Research Experience Fellows
experiences.subtitle: National University of Singapore
workDescription: Development of a Power Management System for Roti Proa II, a solar-wind powered boat, consisting of the combination of firmware, software, and hardware application.
Implemented a framework using a network of **ESP32**s and **Raspberry Pi** to wirelessly monitor and control an array of sensors throughout the boat.
Creation of a custom PCB and 3D printed enclosure for high frequency sensor.
Developed a **web-based dashboard** using **MERN** with communication via serial with the sensors to visualize the power consumption data and provide real-time feedback to the user.
**Digital twin** simulation & automatic electrical validation for range prediction of the vessel.
Integration of a workflow orchestration framework using a parametised value of the system (Physical layout and dimention of the boad and electrical system)

experiences.title: Lightweight Workflow Orchestration for AI-Assisted Parametric Engineering
experiences.subtitle: National University of Singapore
workDescription: Co-authored a research and development of a Parametric Workflow Orchestration system
Simulate and validate results of parametised value of the system using **CAD** and **physics simulations** of mechanical and electrical components.
Integration of a step-by-step design principle with dependency management using **GNU Make**
Case study of **Roti Proa II**, where the vessel is built upon validated result from the system.
